scenario_text: A traveling depolarization wave propagates along an unmyelinated axon, and its conduction speed is measured for axons of varying diameter. Larger diameter reduces internal resistance and increases propagation velocity in a scaling relationship. We seek how conduction velocity depends on axon diameter. This addresses the geometric determinants of signal propagation.
